findings.risk: User-controlled data may alter database query structure and could expose or modify database records.
findings.evidence: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + user_input + "'"
findings.remediation: Use a parameterized query or safe ORM API; never concatenate untrusted input into SQL.

findings.attack_type: Credential exposure / account or service abuse
findings.risk: An exposed credential could be reused if the source is obtained.
findings.remediation: Move the secret to environment variables or a managed secret store and rotate it.

rag_guidance.name: SQL Injection
rag_guidance.description: Untrusted input can alter the structure of a database query when it is concatenated into SQL.
rag_guidance.impact: May expose, change, or delete database data depending on application privileges.
rag_guidance.remediation: Use parameterized queries or a safe ORM API. Validate inputs and use least-privilege database accounts.

rag_guidance.name: Cross-Site Scripting
rag_guidance.description: Untrusted data reaches an HTML or script-sensitive output context without appropriate encoding or sanitization.
rag_guidance.impact: May allow attacker-controlled browser content in another user's session, depending on the sink and context.
rag_guidance.remediation: Prefer safe text rendering and context-aware output encoding. Sanitize HTML only when HTML is actually required.

rag_guidance.name: Hardcoded Credentials
rag_guidance.description: Secrets embedded in source code can be exposed through repositories, logs, builds, or source distribution.
rag_guidance.impact: Could enable unauthorized use of the associated service or account if the credential remains valid.
rag_guidance.remediation: Use environment variables or a secret manager and rotate exposed credentials.

executive_summary: The demo contains a critical SQL-injection risk and a high-risk hardcoded secret. These are static-analysis findings: they indicate dangerous code patterns, but exploitability depends on how input reaches the code and what privileges the application has.
